description: Migrate workbook project and lesson persistence from the local filesystem to Supabase (Postgres + Storage), and enable multiple content team members to collaborate on the same project simultaneously.
deviation_notes: SUPERSEDED AND INCORRECT. The Supabase stack described here does not exist and was never adopted; the monorepo uses a provider-neutral platform (Postgres via @reading-advantage/db + Drizzle, S3-compatible object storage via @reading-advantage/storage, tRPC via @reading-advantage/api, first-party auth via @reading-advantage/auth). Direct @supabase imports are denylisted by monorepo architecture enforcement. The real migration is defined in the monorepo at measure/tracks/workbook_content_versioning_20260711 (Workbook Publishing Platform and Ecosystem Import), which imports this repo as apps/workbooks. Archived unstarted 2026-08-02; do not implement.
